description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects selected operating-system file targets under Vite filesystem routes.
affected_versions: vitejs vite: >= 6.2.0, < 6.2.4, >= 6.1.0, < 6.1.3, >= 6.0.0, < 6.0.13, >= 5.0.0, < 5.4.16, < 4.5.11; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects selected operating-system file targets under Vite filesystem routes.
limitations: This matches two known targets only, not arbitrary file disclosure; never publicly expose a vulnerable development server. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Development projects intentionally serving these operating-system file names are denied.
